title: Deep Review Artifact Envelope
description: EVERY collection artifact (02-findings/*, 03-verdicts, 03-refuted, 03-unadmitted, 04-ledger) is this shape. Schemas for single objects validate one element; this validates the file. PRODUCER: every phase emitting a collection. CONSUMER: the validator each phase runs on its inputs.

baseline_sha.description: The pinned Phase 0 sha every item was computed against. A phase MUST reject an input whose baseline_sha differs from its own.

nonce_verified.description: False MUST fail the lane for a proxied producer.

dropped.description: Items excluded by a cap, retained IN FULL. Never a count.
